title: Durian Satay with Oozy Peanut Sauce
description: A Southeast Asian-inspired satay dish featuring durian, served with a creamy and slightly sweet peanut sauce. This recipe is perfect for adventurous foodies looking to try something new.
instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. In a large bowl, combine durian, coconut milk, honey, lime juice, and fish sauce. Mix well to coat the durian.
3. Thread the satay skewers onto metal or bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
4. Grill the satay skewers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
5. Meanwhile, warm the oozy peanut sauce in a small saucepan over low heat.
6. Serve the grilled satay skewers with the warm peanut sauce spooned over the top.
